name: git-next
description: Git safety oracle for AI agents — inspects repo state, blocks dangerous commands, and tells you what to do next.
long_description: git-next analyzes your git repository state and surfaces prioritized advice, from 'dangerous, stop immediately' down to 'mild suggestion'. For AI agents it exposes 7 MCP tools: **git_status** for full repo analysis, **git_guard** for pre-flight command checking, **git_run** with a SAFE/GUARDED/BLOCKED execution model (guarded commands like push/merge require explicit confirmation; blocked commands like force-push on protected branches are never executed), **git_explain** for rule explanations, **git_diff**, **git_log**, and **git_remote_status**. Zero configuration required — works in any git repository.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Inspect current repo state and get prioritized advice. Call this first before running any git commands.

tools.name: git_guard
tools.description: Check whether a proposed git command is safe to run given current repo state. Never executes.

tools.name: git_run
tools.description: Run a git command with SAFE/GUARDED/BLOCKED safety enforcement. Guarded commands require confirmed=true; blocked commands are never executed.

tools.name: git_explain
tools.description: Get a full explanation of a git-next rule ID — why it matters and what to do instead.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Get staged or unstaged diff, optionally filtered to a single file.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Get recent commit history as structured JSON.

tools.name: git_remote_status
tools.description: Check ahead/behind count vs remote branch. Makes a network call — use explicitly.
